children: NFL Sunday Ticket subscribers are paying more for fewer games as the league moves an increasing number of matchups into stand-alone national time slots.

The package carried 191 games last season, down nearly 10% from 211 in 2021, according to Wall Street Journal research. Early Sunday afternoon games fell 13% to 127 during the same period. Sunday Ticket is expected to offer about 200 games this season, still below its 2021 total.
Meanwhile, the regular price for YouTube TV
subscribers has risen to $378, nearly 30% more than the $293.94 DirecTV
charged existing customers during its final years with the package. Viewers without YouTube TV can pay as much as $480, though promotional discounts are common.
The NFL has shifted games to Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Monday, while adding international and holiday contests. Netflix
carries Christmas games and will add a Thanksgiving Eve matchup this season. Amazon

Those contests are sold separately and aren’t included in Sunday Ticket, which focuses on out-of-market Sunday afternoon games. Popular teams also tend to appear in national broadcasts, leaving the package with fewer high-profile matchups.

The changing Sunday Ticket lineup shows how the NFL is creating more broadcast windows to generate additional media-rights revenue. That benefits the league but raises questions about the economics for distributors. Alphabet’s YouTube reportedly pays more than $2 billion annually for Sunday Ticket, compared with about $1.5 billion under DirecTV’s previous agreement, despite receiving fewer games.
YouTube views the package as a long-term tool for attracting subscribers and advertisers. Alphabet
has said YouTube TV subscriber growth accelerated after Sunday Ticket arrived. Still, Morgan Stanley previously estimated that YouTube could lose nearly $9 billion over the seven-year contract.
The strategy also has implications for Netflix, Amazon, Fox

, which are paying heavily for increasingly fragmented NFL rights. Live football remains one of the few reliable sources of mass audiences, but distributors must determine how much those viewers are worth when fans can subscribe selectively or wait for discounts.

Sunday Ticket has about 1.8 million subscribers, according to Antenna. Whether YouTube can turn those customers into broader subscription and advertising growth will help determine whether the package becomes a valuable gateway or an expensive loss leader.

title: NFL Sunday Ticket offers fewer games at a higher price
